sources.title: Calibration - Canadian Instrumentation Services Group
sources.excerpt: CISG describes itself as an independent privately owned laboratory calibrating pressure, temperature, dimensional and electrical instruments.

sources.title: Contact Us - CISG
sources.excerpt: The office is in Peterborough, Ontario.

notes: Self-reported control; verify ownership and accreditation scope before reliance.

sources.title: Nos services - PPM Métrologie
sources.excerpt: Lists calibration of electrical, temperature, pressure and some dimensional instruments; gives Granby headquarters.

notes: Ownership and current accredited scope are unresolved.

sources.title: Services d'étalonnage - ATEK
sources.excerpt: Saint-Laurent lab offers temperature calibration; pressure calibration availability and accreditation must be confirmed. A2LA certificate 7486.01 covers a defined scope.

notes: Pressure service is conditional, not confirmed accredited capability; control unresolved.

sources.title: Vidya Instruments Calibration
sources.excerpt: Lists in-lab and on-site electrical, pressure and temperature calibration and a Brampton location.

sources.title: Corporations Canada - Vidya Instruments Calibration Inc.
sources.rights: Government of Canada terms; short paraphrase
sources.excerpt: Federal corporation 1312470-3 is active.

notes: A women-business-enterprise statement is not sufficient evidence of independent control.

sources.title: Montreal calibration lab - Transcat Canada
sources.excerpt: Transcat's Montreal calibration lab lists temperature, electricity, pressure and dimensional capabilities.

sources.title: About Transcat Canada
sources.excerpt: Ulrich Metrology is part of Transcat Canada, which identifies Transcat as its US parent.

notes: A current group-operated lab, not an independent acquisition candidate; Ulrich is a historical acquired name, not a separate current site.

sources.title: Calibration Laboratory - Mitutoyo Canada
sources.excerpt: Mississauga calibration lab specializes in dimensional instruments and reference standards.

notes: Scope mismatch candidate: no electrical, pressure or temperature service established by this source; absence of evidence is not evidence of absence. Control unresolved.

sources.title: EPI Fire Protection Inc. - OECM
sources.excerpt: OECM describes North York-based EPI as locally owned and operated, and lists inspection, maintenance and periodic testing of fire alarm systems.

notes: Locally owned and operated is a self-reported or supplier-profile statement, not proof of ultimate control.

sources.title: Rohen Fire is Now Part of OFS Group
sources.excerpt: OFS announces acquisition of Rohen Fire and describes combined Scarborough-area fire alarm inspection, testing and maintenance.

sources.title: OFS Group Greater Toronto Area branch
sources.excerpt: The former Rohen Fire operation is now operating as OFS Group at a physical Scarborough branch.

notes: Acquired brand, scored at the current OFS location. The service description covers the combined offering.

sources.title: Carrières - Alarme SL
sources.excerpt: Describes a family business in Longueuil and a commercial-building fire alarm inspection role.

sources.title: Alarme incendie - Alarme SL
sources.excerpt: Lists initial and annual fire alarm inspections and maintained and inspected products.

sources.title: Sécur-Icare and Alarme SL merger announcement
sources.excerpt: Sécur-Icare announced that it and Alarme SL merged and would move to a joint Longueuil location while retaining their names at the time.

notes: The family-business description persists alongside a merger disclosure from the other party. The combined operation fails the standalone acquisition brief.

sources.title: Fire alarm and detection - Precise Fire Protection
sources.excerpt: Lists annual fire alarm inspection and testing, as well as maintenance such as battery replacement and detector cleaning.

sources.title: Precise Fire Protection
sources.excerpt: Lists an Ottawa location and says the company is supported by the Altus Fire & Life Safety family of companies.

sources.title: Precise Fire Protection - Altus
sources.excerpt: Altus identifies Precise as a partner based in Ottawa.

notes: Group label based on explicit Altus family affiliation; legal ownership percentage not established.

sources.title: Control Fire Systems
sources.excerpt: Describes itself as an independent Toronto fire protection company offering fire alarm inspection and maintenance.

sources.title: Fire alarm inspection and testing - Control Fire Systems
sources.excerpt: Describes inspection, testing and repair for commercial fire alarm systems.

notes: Independence is a company statement, not an independent beneficial-ownership search.

sources.title: Contact Us - Firechek
sources.excerpt: Lists a Sudbury location and fire alarm service and maintenance.

sources.title: Firechek
sources.excerpt: Describes a local family-owned company serving commercial clients.

notes: Inspection of fire alarms not established by these pages; the inspection-only requirement is unresolved, not a demonstrated negative. Family ownership does not establish ultimate control.
